purpose: A Minecraft harness so AI agents can learn skills from player demonstrations and act through a fast observation/action bridge.
short_description: Agent37 gives AI agents a Minecraft body they can sense and control in under a quarter second, with a browser takeover so people can demonstrate skills. The team is building structured observations, craft and combat skills, and a learning path toward bots that reach the Nether from a fresh spawn. The V4 learned combat model and dataset pipeline landed in Fall 2026. Planned next: a fast perception layer to feed the planner before the Nov 16 club showcase. Stack: Node.js, Mineflayer, optional ONNX. Built by the SJSU AI/ML Club for students and visitors who want to see autonomous Minecraft agents in action.
